evidence.title: MAPS Responds to Report of Progress for MDMA-assisted therapy for PTSD with FDA
Two Years After Rejection, Resilient Quietly Refiles MDMA for PTSD Application
FDA Briefing Document, NDA 215455, midomafetamine capsules, Psychopharmacologic Drugs Advisory Committee
Drugs@FDA: FDA-Approved Drugs (search for midomafetamine / MDMA)

outcomes.note: No FDA approval of midomafetamine for PTSD exists, so no approved labeling or REMS can be read. FDA issued a complete response letter on 2024-08-09 for NDA 215455 (Lykos). Resilient Pharmaceuticals (ex-Lykos) resubmitted the NDA on about 2026-08-09, announced 2026-08-10, without a new phase 3; the application is under review with no action date reported. Drugs@FDA lists no approved midomafetamine product at the access date. A resubmission and an open review are not an approval, so the criterion stays unmet as of 2026-09-14. This says nothing about later dates.

outcomes.note: Health Canada lists no Notice of Compliance for a midomafetamine (MDMA) product. The Drug Product Database returns no record for the ingredient midomafetamine or methylenedioxymethamphetamine, and none for the proposed brand name Rysanso. MDMA in Canada is reached only through the Special Access Program, which the criterion excludes. The sponsor, Resilient Pharmaceuticals, reports no Canadian filing; its 2026-08-10 news concerns the US NDA resubmission only. Checked 2026-09-14; this says nothing about later dates.

outcomes.note: The Israel Drug Registry shows no registered midomafetamine (MDMA) product for PTSD. Access in Israel remains through Ministry of Health approved clinical trials and the 2019 compassionate-use programme, both excluded by the criterion; a December 2025 report states MDMA is available only through Health Ministry approved trials. No sponsor has announced an Israeli registration. Caveat: the registry search interface needs a form query, so the check combines the registry site with dated secondary reports. Checked 2026-09-14; this says nothing about later dates.

evidence.title: MDMA-assisted Brief Cognitive Behavioral Conjoint Therapy for PTSD (NCT05979844), Phase 3, sponsor Dr. Leslie Morland, VA San Diego Healthcare System; actual start 2023-10-06
MDMA-assisted Massed Prolonged Exposure for PTSD (NCT06117306), Phase 3, sponsor Healing Breakthrough; actual start 2024-10-25
IISPT2: Examining MDMA Effects in Veterans With PTSD and Moral Injury (NCT06394284), Phase 3, sponsor Herzog Hospital, Israel; actual start 2024-02-18
MDMA-Assisted Therapy for Veterans With PTSD and Alcohol Use Disorder (NCT07118839), Phase 2/Phase 3, sponsor VA Office of Research and Development; actual start 2026-05-18

outcomes.note: Criterion (a) is met. The first interventional Phase 3 MDMA-for-PTSD trial with a sponsor outside the MAPS programme is NCT05979844 (Dr. Leslie Morland, VA San Diego), actual start 2023-10-06; it administers MDMA and produces its own data, with Resilient (ex-Lykos) only a collaborator supplying drug. Three later independent records confirm the pattern: NCT06117306 (Healing Breakthrough, 2024-10-25), NCT06394284 (Herzog Hospital, 2024-02-18) and NCT07118839 (VA ORD, Phase 2/3, 2026-05-18). NCT06189027 (USC, start 2018-11-20) is excluded: it is a saliva biomarker add-on to the MAPS trial MAPP1 and gives no drug itself.

evidence.title: FDA Agrees to Expanded Access Program for MDMA-Assisted Therapy for PTSD
MAPS Wins Appeal and Authorization to Study MDMA in Healthy Volunteer Therapists
From the Desk of Rick Doblin, Ph.D. - Winter 2021 (MAPS Bulletin)
Research News - Spring 2020 (MAPS Bulletin)

outcomes.note: Two of the three proposals are reported accepted, the third is not. MAPS announced FDA agreement to the Expanded Access programme on 2020-01-17 (FDA notice 2019-12-20), and on 2021-05-12 announced that FDA granted its appeal and authorized the study giving MDMA to healthy volunteer therapists. On co-therapist credentials MAPS reports the opposite of acceptance: the Expanded Access release states FDA is requiring at least one therapist of each pair to hold a medical or clinical doctorate. No MAPS press release or Bulletin reports all three as accepted. Checked 2026-09-14; this says nothing about later dates.

outcomes.note: Drugs@FDA lists no approved midomafetamine (MDMA) product for any indication, so no approval for an indication other than PTSD exists. The single US application is NDA 215455 for PTSD: complete response letter 2024-08-09, resubmitted by Resilient Pharmaceuticals about 2026-08-09 and announced 2026-08-10, still for PTSD and still under review. No sponsor has announced an MDMA application for an eating disorder, social anxiety or a substance use disorder. Checked 2026-09-14; this says nothing about later dates.

evidence.title: Study Comparing Two Versus Three Active MDMA-assisted Sessions in U.S. Military Veterans With Chronic PTSD (NCT04784143), sole site James J. Peters VA Medical Center, The Bronx, NY; actual start 2021-11-08
NCT04784143 record history: version 5, submitted 2021-11-16 and posted 2021-11-17, is the first version with overall status and Bronx VA site status Recruiting
Phase 2 Study at the Bronx, New York Veterans Affairs Medical Center
Site Initiation Visit Takes Place for Phase 2 Study at the Veterans Affairs Medical Center in Bronx, New York

outcomes.note: Criterion (c) fixes the date. The MAPS-sponsored study at the James J. Peters VA Medical Center in the Bronx (NCT04784143, PI Rachel Yehuda) was first posted with the Bronx VA site and the study at status Recruiting in record version 5, submitted 2021-11-16 and posted publicly 2021-11-17; that same version gives an actual study start of 2021-11-08. Dosing MDMA at the site requires the DEA Schedule I registration, so the start is accepted as evidence that it was granted. The study later enrolled 26 participants. Earlier MAPS pages (2021-02-25, 2021-09-22) still describe the registration as pending. No separate DEA grant announcement was found, so the posted Recruiting status is the first verifiable date.
